checks.command: l4 run ea-part2-cases.l4 ; l4 run ea-parts-3-and-4-cases.l4
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: Parts 2, 3 and 4 in full, out of 16 Parts. Part 2 ss 8-14 (termination, notice, dismissal) and ss 15-18A (danger, breach, trade union rights, continuity across a change of employer). Part 3 ss 20-33 (salary periods, the incomplete-month formula, payment deadlines, and the whole deduction scheme with its ceilings). Part 4 ss 36-46 (rest day, the rest-day payment table, hours of work and its four provisos, overtime at one and a half times, the 72-hour monthly and 12-hour daily ceilings, shift workers and the three-week average, and the retrenchment and retirement qualifying periods). NOT ENCODED: s 35, which decides WHETHER PART 4 APPLIES to a given employee at all - a real omission, flagged in NOTES.md. Also not encoded: s 19, s 34, s 39, ss 41-41A, ss 47-53, and Parts 5 to 16.
